name: workspace-checkpoint-by-a-bound-session-refuses-an-absent-principal
description: /workspace/checkpoint is require-class (_CALLER_PRINCIPAL_POSTURE). The preflight CLAIMS session A; a checkpoint naming the bound A without its principal is refused with the typed absent reason before any manifest is written, so a caller that lost its principal cannot record a manifest as A's. Twin of 22 (same request, principal presented). Rows 01-20 name unbound sessions, which the require class admits.

body.error: missing Coherence-Caller-Principal header: this route requires the caller principal that POST /principal/claim bound to the session_id it names (caller_principal_absent)
